text: Thank you for that detailed history. To better assess the nature of your skin lesions, can you describe the ABCDE features of your most concerning spot (Asymmetry, Border, Color, Diameter, and Evolution)?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is concerning; given your age, smoking history, and the non-healing nature of both the penile and digital lesions, have you noticed any bleeding, rapid growth, or pain in these spots?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, CBC (to check for anemia from chronic bleeding) and Serum Alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP).
REQUEST IMAGES: Dermoscopy of the penile lesion and the digital lesion.
